images.prompt: Edit this panel into the required UPPER-LEFT FAR RUINS parallax panel, 1536×1024. Correct the foreground cliff rim and smoke contaminating the green sky area. Entire top area from y=0 through y=680 MUST be perfectly flat solid #00ff00 RGB(0,255,0), with no objects whatsoever. All mountain peaks, temple tops and ruin tops must fall between y=681 and y=860; valleys between peaks near y=850. Make the temple smaller and truly distant. Remove ALL foreground cliff rims, foreground ledges, trees, glowing rivers, foreground scenery and large fire sources. The only painted content is a distant cool violet jagged mountain range with a far plateau and small recently destroyed temple remains: split collapsed dome, broken columns, fallen statues, charred blue banners, restrained tiny embers. Confine any thin smoke entirely below the land's top silhouette; no smoke in green. Below the top silhouette paint distant violet cliffs fully to bottom edge, growing simpler and hazier toward bottom. Nothing below land silhouette is green. Everything above the exact land/ruin silhouette, including gaps through ruins, is pure uniform #00ff00 with no gradients, texture or color variation. Hand-drawn painted 2D animation look, tapered hand-drawn contours, clean painted planes, thin light distant linework, restrained texture, cool violet haze, subtle warm sunset rim light from upper left, monumental ivory/blue/brass ceremonial observatory ruins. No characters, creatures, text, UI, borders or vignette. Natural continuous terrain across side and bottom crop edges. This is a distant isolated land layer, mostly green, with landscape occupying only the bottom third. Output one 1536×1024 PNG.
